import pandas as pd
import zipfile
import csv

# Read clean stops
stops = pd.read_csv("outputs/t05_clean_stops.csv")

# Read clean stop times
stop_times = pd.read_csv("outputs/t05_clean_stop_times.csv")

# Extract trips.txt from the GTFS zip
with zipfile.ZipFile("inputs/gtfs/sample_city_gtfs.zip", "r") as z:
    trips = pd.read_csv(z.open("trips.txt"))

# Merge stop_times with trips to get route_id
stop_times_with_routes = stop_times.merge(trips[["trip_id", "route_id"]], on="trip_id", how="left")

# Group by stop_id
grouped = stop_times_with_routes.groupby("stop_id").agg(
    n_departures=("trip_id", "count"),
    n_routes=("route_id", "nunique"),
    first_departure=("departure_time", "min"),
    last_departure=("departure_time", "max")
).reset_index()

# Merge with stops to get stop_name, stop_lat, stop_lon
result = stops.merge(grouped, on="stop_id", how="left")

# Select and order columns
result = result[["stop_id", "stop_name", "stop_lat", "stop_lon", "n_departures", "n_routes", "first_departure", "last_departure"]]

# Write to CSV with RFC 4180 compliance
result.to_csv("outputs/t06_stop_service_intensity.csv", index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL)
</solution_file>

import pandas as pd
import zipfile
import csv

# Read clean stop times

    trips = pd.read_csv(z.open("trips.txt"))

# Group by stop_id
grouped = stop_times_with_routes.groupby("stop_id").agg(
    n_departures=("trip_id", "count"),
    n_routes=("route_id", "nunique"),
    first_departure=("departure_time", "min"),
    last_departure=("departure_time", "max")
).reset_index()

# Merge with stops to get stop_name, stop_lat, stop_lon
result = stops.merge(grouped, on="stop_id", how="left")

# Select and order columns
result = result[["stop_id", "stop_name", "stop_lat", "stop_lon", "n_departures", "n_routes", "first_departure", "last_departure"]]
